results.rationale: The glass, pouring stream and splash shape are preserved. A soft ground shadow and centered uppercase sans-serif headline are added in a clean white layout; the wording is correct but the lettering is darker than the requested light silver-gray. The final image has natural glass structure, a coherent splash and legible typography.

The monitor and cuff remain recognizable, but the date/time becomes garbled text and multiple small labels are distorted. Pressure changes from 123/72 to 118/78, neither meeting the supplied below-90 systolic or below-60 diastolic criterion. Instruction failure implies knowledge invalid. The display's nonsense header and malformed labels create multiple distracting semantic artifacts.
